metadata.name: Cult of the Wool
metadata.description: A roguelike cult management game inspired by Cult of the Lamb. Build your flock, manage their needs, and go on crusades to defeat the Bishops.

content.bundle:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>Cult of the Wool</title>
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#111}canvas{display:block}</style>
</head><body><canvas id="gc"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
// ===== VARIABLE DECLARATIONS (ALL BEFORE ANY FUNCTION CALLS) =====
var canvas, ctx, W, H, keys, mouseX, mouseY, mouseDown, mouseClicked;
var gameState, prevState, dt, lastTime, frameCount;
var player, followers, buildings, enemies, projectiles, particles, lootDrops;
var resources, day, dayTimer, dayDuration, nightAlpha, devotion;
var unlockedBuildings, bossesDefeated, globalStats;
var baseGrid, gridW, gridH, tileSize, cameraX, cameraY;
var crusadeRegion, crusadeRoom, crusadeMaxRooms, roomEnemies, roomCleared;
var bossHP, bossMaxHP, bossPhase, bossAttackTimer, bossEnraged;
var tarotCards, tarotChoices, showTarotChoice, collectedLoot;
var menuOptions, menuSelection, interactTarget, interactMenu, interactSubMenu;
var buildMode, buildSelection, buildCursor, availableBuilds;
var roomChoices, showRoomChoice, screenShakeX, screenShakeY, screenShakeTimer;
var titlePulse, titleAlpha, transitionAlpha, transitionDir, transitionTarget;
var pauseMenu, gameOverMsg, victoryStats, sermonUsedToday;
var followerNames = ['Basil','Clover','Daisy','Pepper','Sage','Thyme','Rosie','Bramble','Fern','Moss','Olive','Poppy','Willow','Cedar','Maple','Birch','Holly','Ivy','Laurel','Reed'];
var animalTypes = ['chicken','pig','goat'];
var weaponTypes = ['Sword','Axe','Dagger'];
var currentWeapon, attackTimer, attackCooldown, attackAngle, isAttacking;
var dodgeTimer, dodgeCooldown, dodgeDir, isDodging, iFrameTimer;
var killCount, vampireKillAccum;
var TILE = 48, GRIDW = 20, GRIDH = 15;
var PI = Math.PI, TWO_PI = PI * 2, HALF_PI = PI / 2;
var saveKey = 'cult-of-sheep-save';
var hasSave = false;
var titleSelection = 0;
var crusadeLootGold = 0, crusadeLootWood = 0, crusadeLootStone = 0, crusadeLootFood = 0;
var playerInvincible = false;
var bossType = '';
var pendingFollower = null;
var mealCount = 0;
var hoverBtn = -1;
var ritualAnim = 0, ritualType = '';
var followerSickDays = {};
var maxFollowers = 4;
var FONT = '16px monospace';
var FONTB = 'bold 16px monospace';
var FONTL = 'bold 32px monospace';
var FONTXL = 'bold 48px monospace';
var FONTT = 'bold 64px monospace';
var flashMsg = '', flashTimer = 0;
var spriteImages = {};
var spritesReady = {};

function loadSprite(name, path) {
  var img = new Image();
  img.onload = function() { spritesReady[name] = true; };
  img.onerror = function() { spritesReady[name] = false; };
  img.src = path;
  spriteImages[name] = img;
}

// ===== INITIALIZATION =====
function getW(){return document.documentElement.clientWidth||window.innerWidth||960}
function getH(){return document.documentElement.clientHeight||window.innerHeight||540}

function init(){
  canvas = document.getElementById('gc');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  W = getW(); H = getH();
  canvas.width = W; canvas.height = H;
  keys = {}; mouseX = 0; mouseY = 0; mouseDown = false; mouseClicked = false;
  gameState = 'TITLE'; prevState = ''; dt = 0; lastTime = 0; frameCount = 0;
  titlePulse = 0; titleAlpha = 0; transitionAlpha = 0; transitionDir = 0; transitionTarget = '';
  screenShakeX = 0; screenShakeY = 0; screenShakeTimer = 0;
  try{hasSave = !!localStorage.getItem(saveKey)}catch(e){hasSave=false}
  titleSelection = 0;
  // Load NanoBanana-generated sprites (fall back to programmatic if they fail)
  loadSprite('player','assets/player-sheep.png');
  loadSprite('chicken','assets/follower-chicken.png');
  loadSprite('pig','assets/follower-pig.png');
  loadSprite('goat','assets/follower-goat.png');
  loadSprite('wolf','assets/enemy-wolf.png');
  loadSprite('fox','assets/enemy-fox.png');
  loadSprite('snake','assets/enemy-snake.png');
  loadSprite('spider','assets/enemy-spider.png');
  loadSprite('boss-bear','assets/boss-bear.png');
  loadSprite('temple','assets/building-temple.png');
  loadSprite('shrine','assets/building-shrine.png');
  loadSprite('title','data:image/webp;base64,');
  setupInput();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function setupInput(){
  window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;keys[e.code]=true;if(['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].indexOf(e.code)>=0)e.preventDefault()});
  window.addEventListener('keyup',function(e){keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false;keys[e.code]=false});
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){mouseX=e.clientX;mouseY=e.clientY});
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){mouseDown=true;mouseClicked=true});
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup',function(e){mouseDown=false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){var t=e.touches[0];mouseX=t.clientX;mouseY=t.clientY;mouseDown=true;mouseClicked=true;e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){mouseDown=false});
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){W=getW();H=getH();canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H});
}

// ===== MAIN LOOP =====
function loop(ts){
  if(!lastTime)lastTime=ts;
  dt=Math.min((ts-lastTime)/1000,0.05);
  lastTime=ts;
  frameCount++;
  try{update(dt);render()}catch(e){console.error('Game error:',e)}
  mouseClicked=false;
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

function update(dt){
  titlePulse+=dt*2;
  if(transitionDir!==0){
    transitionAlpha+=transitionDir*dt*3;
    if(transitionAlpha>=1){transitionAlpha=1;transitionDir=-1;doTransition()}
    else if(transitionAlpha<=0){transitionAlpha=0;transitionDir=0}
    return;
  }
  if(screenShakeTimer>0){screenShakeTimer-=dt;screenShakeX=(Math.random()-0.5)*6;screenShakeY=(Math.random()-0.5)*6;if(screenShakeTimer<=0){screenShakeX=0;screenShakeY=0}}
  if(gameState==='TITLE')updateTitle(dt);
  else if(gameState==='BASE')updateBase(dt);
  else if(gameState==='CRUSADE')updateCrusade(dt);
  else if(gameState==='BUILD')updateBuild(dt);
  else if(gameState==='ROOM_CHOICE')updateRoomChoice(dt);
  else if(gameState==='PAUSE')updatePause(dt);
  else if(gameState==='GAMEOVER')updateGameOver(dt);
}

function render(){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(screenShakeX,screenShakeY);
  ctx.fillStyle='#111';ctx.fillRect(-10,-10,W+20,H+20);
  if(gameState==='TITLE')renderTitle();
  else if(gameState==='BASE'||gameState==='BUILD')renderBase();
  else if(gameState==='CRUSADE')renderCrusade();
  else if(gameState==='ROOM_CHOICE')renderCrusade();
  else if(gameState==='PAUSE'){if(prevState==='BASE'||prevState==='BUILD')renderBase();else renderCrusade();renderPause()}
  else if(gameState==='GAMEOVER')renderGameOver();
  if(transitionAlpha>0){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+transitionAlpha+')';ctx.fillRect(-10,-10,W+20,H+20)}
  ctx.restore();
}

function startTransition(target){transitionDir=1;transitionAlpha=0;transitionTarget=target}
function doTransition(){
  if(transitionTarget==='NEW_GAME'){newGame();gameState='BASE'}
  else if(transitionTarget==='LOAD_GAME'){loadGame();gameState='BASE'}
  else if(transitionTarget==='BASE'){player.x=16*TILE+24;player.y=7*TILE+24;player.hp=player.maxHp;player.moving=false;enemies=[];projectiles=[];interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;buildMode=false;saveGame();gameState='BASE'}
  else if(transitionTarget==='CRUSADE'){startCrusade();gameState='CRUSADE'}
  else if(transitionTarget==='GAMEOVER'){gameState='GAMEOVER'}
  else gameState=transitionTarget;
}

// ===== TITLE SCREEN =====
function updateTitle(dt){
  titleAlpha=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(titlePulse);
  if(hasSave){
    if(mouseClicked){
      var cy=H/2+60;
      if(mouseY>cy-20&&mouseY<cy+20&&mouseX>W/2-100&&mouseX<W/2+100){startTransition('LOAD_GAME')}
      cy+=50;
      if(mouseY>cy-20&&mouseY<cy+20&&mouseX>W/2-100&&mouseX<W/2+100){startTransition('NEW_GAME')}
    }
  }else{
    if(mouseClicked){startTransition('NEW_GAME')}
  }
}

function renderTitle(){
  // starry bg
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0a1a';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  var seed=42;
  for(var i=0;i<80;i++){
    seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;
    var sx=(seed%W);seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;
    var sy=(seed%H);
    var twinkle=0.3+0.7*Math.abs(Math.sin(titlePulse+i));
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+twinkle+')';
    ctx.fillRect(sx,sy,2,2);
  }
  // logo art
  ctx.textAlign='center';
  if(spritesReady['title']){var tw=Math.min(360,H*0.55),th=tw;ctx.drawImage(spriteImages['title'],W/2-tw/2,H/2-th/2-20,tw,th)}
  else{drawTitleSheep(W/2, H/2-10)}
  // buttons
  ctx.font=FONTB;
  if(hasSave){
    drawButton(W/2,H/2+60,'Continue',0);
    drawButton(W/2,H/2+110,'New Game',1);
  }else{
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+titleAlpha+')';
    ctx.fillText('Click to Begin',W/2,H-55);
  }
  // controls
  ctx.font='14px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#888';
  ctx.fillText('WASD: Move | E: Interact | B: Build | Space: Attack | Shift: Dodge | ESC: Pause',W/2,H-30);
}

function drawTitleSheep(x,y){
  var pulse=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(titlePulse*1.5);
  // body
  ctx.fillStyle='#444';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,36,28,0,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#ddd';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-20,18,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  // eyes - pulsing red
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,0,'+(0.4+0.6*pulse)+')';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-6,y-22,4,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+6,y-22,4,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  // glow
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,0,'+(0.1+0.15*pulse)+')';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-20,28,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  // crown
  ctx.fillStyle='#cc0000';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-10,y-36);ctx.lineTo(x-6,y-46);ctx.lineTo(x-2,y-36);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-4,y-36);ctx.lineTo(x,y-50);ctx.lineTo(x+4,y-36);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+2,y-36);ctx.lineTo(x+6,y-46);ctx.lineTo(x+10,y-36);ctx.fill();
  // legs
  ctx.fillStyle='#333';
  ctx.fillRect(x-20,y+20,6,12);ctx.fillRect(x-8,y+20,6,12);
  ctx.fillRect(x+4,y+20,6,12);ctx.fillRect(x+16,y+20,6,12);
}

function drawButton(x,y,text,idx){
  var hover=mouseX>x-100&&mouseX<x+100&&mouseY>y-20&&mouseY<y+20;
  ctx.fillStyle=hover?'rgba(200,50,50,0.8)':'rgba(60,60,60,0.8)';
  roundRect(x-100,y-20,200,40,8,true,false);
  ctx.fillStyle=hover?'#fff':'#ccc';
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.font=FONTB;
  ctx.fillText(text,x,y+6);
}

// ===== NEW GAME =====
function newGame(){
  resources={wood:20,stone:10,gold:5,food:10};
  mealCount=0; day=1; dayTimer=0; dayDuration=60; nightAlpha=0;
  devotion=0; sermonUsedToday=false;
  unlockedBuildings=['temple','shrine','portal'];
  bossesDefeated=[];
  globalStats={enemiesSlain:0,followersRecruited:2,buildingsBuilt:3};
  maxFollowers=4;
  particles=[];
  // grid
  baseGrid=[];
  for(var gy=0;gy<GRIDH;gy++){baseGrid[gy]=[];for(var gx=0;gx<GRIDW;gx++){
    if(gx<2||gx>=GRIDW-2||gy<2||gy>=GRIDH-2)baseGrid[gy][gx]='tree';
    else baseGrid[gy][gx]='grass';
  }}
  buildings=[];
  placeBuilding('temple',10,7);
  placeBuilding('shrine',8,7);
  placeBuilding('portal',17,7);
  // player
  player={x:10*TILE+24,y:9*TILE+24,w:32,h:32,speed:160,dir:0,moving:false,hp:8,maxHp:8};
  // followers
  followers=[];
  addFollower('chicken');
  addFollower('goat');
  cameraX=0;cameraY=0;
  interactTarget=null;interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;
  buildMode=false;buildSelection=0;buildCursor={x:0,y:0};
  tarotCards=[];
  followerSickDays={};
}

function placeBuilding(type,gx,gy){
  buildings.push({type:type,gx:gx,gy:gy,x:gx*TILE,y:gy*TILE,planted:false,growDays:0,growTimer:0});
  baseGrid[gy][gx]='building';
}

function addFollower(type){
  var n=followerNames[Math.floor(Math.random()*followerNames.length)];
  followers.push({name:n,type:type||animalTypes[Math.floor(Math.random()*3)],hunger:70,faith:80,state:'idle',
    x:(9+Math.random()*3)*TILE,y:(8+Math.random()*3)*TILE,targetX:0,targetY:0,stateTimer:0,sick:false,sickDays:0});
  globalStats.followersRecruited++;
}

// ===== SAVE / LOAD =====
function saveGame(){
  var data={resources:resources,mealCount:mealCount,buildings:buildings.map(function(b){return{type:b.type,gx:b.gx,gy:b.gy,planted:b.planted,growDays:b.growDays}}),
    followers:followers.map(function(f){return{name:f.name,type:f.type,hunger:f.hunger,faith:f.faith,sick:f.sick,sickDays:f.sickDays}}),
    day:day,devotion:devotion,unlockedBuildings:unlockedBuildings,bossesDefeated:bossesDefeated,globalStats:globalStats,maxFollowers:maxFollowers};
  try{localStorage.setItem(saveKey,JSON.stringify(data));hasSave=true}catch(e){}
}

function loadGame(){
  var data;try{data=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(saveKey))}catch(e){data=null}
  if(!data){newGame();return}
  resources=data.resources||{wood:20,stone:10,gold:5,food:10};
  mealCount=data.mealCount||0;
  day=data.day||1;devotion=data.devotion||0;
  unlockedBuildings=data.unlockedBuildings||['temple','shrine','portal'];
  bossesDefeated=data.bossesDefeated||[];
  globalStats=data.globalStats||{enemiesSlain:0,followersRecruited:0,buildingsBuilt:0};
  maxFollowers=data.maxFollowers||4;
  sermonUsedToday=false; particles=[]; dayTimer=0; nightAlpha=0;
  // grid
  baseGrid=[];
  for(var gy=0;gy<GRIDH;gy++){baseGrid[gy]=[];for(var gx=0;gx<GRIDW;gx++){
    if(gx<2||gx>=GRIDW-2||gy<2||gy>=GRIDH-2)baseGrid[gy][gx]='tree';
    else baseGrid[gy][gx]='grass';
  }}
  buildings=[];
  if(data.buildings){data.buildings.forEach(function(b){
    placeBuilding(b.type,b.gx,b.gy);
    var lb=buildings[buildings.length-1];lb.planted=b.planted;lb.growDays=b.growDays;lb.growTimer=0;
  })}
  followers=[];
  if(data.followers){data.followers.forEach(function(f){
    followers.push({name:f.name,type:f.type,hunger:f.hunger,faith:f.faith,state:'idle',
      x:(9+Math.random()*3)*TILE,y:(8+Math.random()*3)*TILE,targetX:0,targetY:0,stateTimer:0,sick:f.sick||false,sickDays:f.sickDays||0});
  })}
  player={x:10*TILE+24,y:9*TILE+24,w:32,h:32,speed:160,dir:0,moving:false,hp:8,maxHp:8};
  cameraX=0;cameraY=0;
  interactTarget=null;interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;
  buildMode=false;buildSelection=0;buildCursor={x:0,y:0};tarotCards=[];followerSickDays={};
}

// ===== BASE UPDATE =====
function updateBase(dt){
  if(flashTimer>0)flashTimer-=dt;
  if(keys['escape']){keys['escape']=false;prevState='BASE';gameState='PAUSE';return}
  if(keys['b']){keys['b']=false;if(!interactMenu){
    // check if any buildable buildings are unlocked
    var hasBuildable=unlockedBuildings.indexOf('farm')>=0||unlockedBuildings.indexOf('cookingfire')>=0||unlockedBuildings.indexOf('shelter')>=0||unlockedBuildings.indexOf('outhouse')>=0;
    if(!hasBuildable){flashMsg='Unlock buildings at the Shrine first! [E]';flashTimer=2.5;return}
    gameState='BUILD';buildMode=true;buildSelection=0;return}}
  // day/night
  dayTimer+=dt;
  var dayProgress=dayTimer/dayDuration;
  if(dayProgress>=1){advanceDay();dayTimer=0}
  nightAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.sin(dayProgress*PI)*0.3);
  // player movement
  var dx=0,dy=0;
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup'])dy=-1;
  if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown'])dy=1;
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft'])dx=-1;
  if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright'])dx=1;
  if(dx!==0&&dy!==0){dx*=0.707;dy*=0.707}
  player.moving=dx!==0||dy!==0;
  if(player.moving)player.dir=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  var nx=player.x+dx*player.speed*dt;
  var ny=player.y+dy*player.speed*dt;
  if(!collidesWithSolid(nx,ny,20))  {player.x=nx;player.y=ny}
  else if(!collidesWithSolid(nx,player.y,20)){player.x=nx}
  else if(!collidesWithSolid(player.x,ny,20)){player.y=ny}
  // clamp
  player.x=Math.max(2*TILE,Math.min((GRIDW-2)*TILE-8,player.x));
  player.y=Math.max(2*TILE,Math.min((GRIDH-2)*TILE-8,player.y));
  // camera
  cameraX=player.x-W/2;cameraY=player.y-H/2;
  cameraX=Math.max(0,Math.min(GRIDW*TILE-W,cameraX));
  cameraY=Math.max(0,Math.min(GRIDH*TILE-H,cameraY));
  // interaction check
  if(!interactMenu){
    interactTarget=null;
    for(var i=0;i<buildings.length;i++){
      var b=buildings[i];
      var bdx=player.x-(b.x+TILE/2),bdy=player.y-(b.y+TILE/2);
      if(Math.sqrt(bdx*bdx+bdy*bdy)<TILE*1.5){interactTarget=b;break}
    }
    if(interactTarget&&(keys['e']||keys['E'])){keys['e']=false;keys['E']=false;openBuildingMenu(interactTarget)}
  }else{
    if(keys['escape']||keys['e']||keys['E']){keys['escape']=false;keys['e']=false;keys['E']=false;interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null}
  }
  // follower AI
  updateFollowers(dt);
  // particles
  updateParticles(dt);
  // menu clicks
  if(interactMenu&&mouseClicked)handleMenuClick();
}

function advanceDay(){
  day++;sermonUsedToday=false;
  // hunger tick
  for(var i=followers.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var f=followers[i];
    f.hunger-=20;if(f.hunger<0)f.hunger=0;
    if(f.hunger===0){f.sickDays++;if(f.sickDays>=2){f.sick=true}if(f.sickDays>=3){
      spawnParticles(f.x,f.y,'#666',10);followers.splice(i,1);
      followers.forEach(function(ff){ff.faith=Math.max(0,ff.faith-10)});continue;
    }}else{f.sickDays=0;f.sick=false}
    // shelter check
    var hasShelter=buildings.some(function(b){return b.type==='shelter'});
    if(!hasShelter)f.faith=Math.max(0,f.faith-5);
    if(f.faith<=0){spawnParticles(f.x,f.y,'#aaa',8);followers.splice(i,1);continue}
  }
  // devotion from shrine praying
  var shrineExists=buildings.some(function(b){return b.type==='shrine'});
  if(shrineExists)devotion+=followers.length;
  // farm growth
  buildings.forEach(function(b){if(b.type==='farm'&&b.planted){b.growDays++;if(b.growDays>=2){b.planted=false;b.growDays=0;b.ready=true}}});
  // check game over
  if(followers.length===0){gameOverMsg='Your cult has crumbled...';startTransition('GAMEOVER')}
  // auto save
  saveGame();
}

function collidesWithSolid(x,y,r){
  var gx=Math.floor(x/TILE),gy=Math.floor(y/TILE);
  for(var dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(var dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){
    var cx=gx+dx,cy=gy+dy;
    if(cx<0||cx>=GRIDW||cy<0||cy>=GRIDH)return true;
    var cell=baseGrid[cy][cx];
    if(cell==='tree'||cell==='building'){
      var bx=cx*TILE+TILE/2,by=cy*TILE+TILE/2;
      if(Math.abs(x-bx)<(TILE/2+r/2)&&Math.abs(y-by)<(TILE/2+r/2))return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

// ===== FOLLOWER AI =====
function updateFollowers(dt){
  for(var i=0;i<followers.length;i++){
    var f=followers[i];
    f.stateTimer-=dt;
    if(f.stateTimer<=0){
      // decide
      if(f.hunger<30&&(resources.food>0||mealCount>0)){
        var fire=buildings.find(function(b){return b.type==='cookingfire'});
        if(fire){f.state='eating';f.targetX=fire.x+TILE/2;f.targetY=fire.y+TILE/2}
        else{f.state='eating';f.targetX=player.x;f.targetY=player.y}
      }else if(f.faith<40){
        var shrine=buildings.find(function(b){return b.type==='shrine'});
        if(shrine){f.state='praying';f.targetX=shrine.x+TILE/2;f.targetY=shrine.y+TILE/2}
        else{f.state='wandering';pickWanderTarget(f)}
      }else{f.state='wandering';pickWanderTarget(f)}
      f.stateTimer=2+Math.random()*3;
    }
    // move toward target
    var fdx=f.targetX-f.x,fdy=f.targetY-f.y;
    var fdist=Math.sqrt(fdx*fdx+fdy*fdy);
    var spd=f.sick?30:60;
    if(fdist>8){f.x+=fdx/fdist*spd*dt;f.y+=fdy/fdist*spd*dt}
    else{
      if(f.state==='eating'){
        if(mealCount>0){mealCount--;f.hunger=Math.min(100,f.hunger+30)}
        else if(resources.food>0){resources.food--;f.hunger=Math.min(100,f.hunger+15)}
        f.state='idle';f.stateTimer=2;
      }
      if(f.state==='praying'){f.faith=Math.min(100,f.faith+5);devotion+=0.5;f.stateTimer=3}
    }
    // clamp
    f.x=Math.max(2*TILE,Math.min((GRIDW-2)*TILE,f.x));

function handleMenuClick(){
  if(!interactMenu)return;
  var opts=interactSubMenu||interactMenu.options;
  var panelH=opts.length*36+20;
  var panelW=280;
  var px=W/2-panelW/2, py=H/2-panelH/2;
  for(var i=0;i<opts.length;i++){
    var oy=py+10+i*36;
    if(mouseX>px&&mouseX<px+panelW&&mouseY>oy&&mouseY<oy+32){
      if(opts[i].disabled)return;
      var act=opts[i].action;
      if(act==='close'||act===null){interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;return}
      if(act==='sermon'){
        sermonUsedToday=true;
        followers.forEach(function(f){f.faith=Math.min(100,f.faith+15)});
        spawnParticles(interactMenu.building.x+TILE/2,interactMenu.building.y,
          '#ff0',12);
        interactMenu=null;return;
      }
      if(act==='ritual'){
        interactSubMenu=[
          {label:'Feast (10 food)',action:'feast',disabled:resources.food<10},
          {label:'Bonfire (5 wood)',action:'bonfire',disabled:resources.wood<5},
          {label:'Sacrifice a follower',action:'sacrifice',disabled:followers.length<2},
          {label:'Back',action:'close'}
        ];return;
      }
      if(act==='feast'){resources.food-=10;followers.forEach(function(f){f.faith=Math.min(100,f.faith+30);f.hunger=Math.min(100,f.hunger+40)});interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;return}
      if(act==='bonfire'){resources.wood-=5;followers.forEach(function(f){f.faith=Math.min(100,f.faith+20)});spawnParticles(interactMenu.building.x+TILE/2,interactMenu.building.y,'#f80',15);interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;return}
      if(act==='sacrifice'){
        if(followers.length>1){
          var victim=followers.splice(Math.floor(Math.random()*followers.length),1)[0];
          resources.gold+=50;
          spawnParticles(victim.x,victim.y,'#800',20);
          followers.forEach(function(f){if(f.faith>50)f.faith=Math.min(100,f.faith+10);else f.faith=Math.max(0,f.faith-15)});
        }
        interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;return;
      }
      if(act&&act.indexOf('unlock_')===0){
        var btype=act.substring(7);
        var costs={farm:5,cookingfire:8,shelter:10,outhouse:3};
        if(devotion>=costs[btype]){devotion-=costs[btype];unlockedBuildings.push(btype)}
        interactMenu=null;return;
      }
      if(act&&act.indexOf('crusade_')===0){
        crusadeRegion=act.substring(8);
        interactMenu=null;startTransition('CRUSADE');return;
      }
      if(act==='plant'){resources.gold-=2;interactMenu.building.planted=true;interactMenu.building.growDays=0;interactMenu.building.ready=false;interactMenu=null;return}
      if(act==='harvest'){resources.food+=6;interactMenu.building.ready=false;interactMenu=null;return}
      if(act==='cook'){resources.food-=3;mealCount+=2;interactMenu=null;return}
      interactMenu=null;interactSubMenu=null;return;
    }
  }
}

function updateBuild(dt){
  if(keys['escape']||keys['b']){keys['escape']=false;keys['b']=false;gameState='BASE';buildMode=false;return}
  // camera still follows player
  var dx=0,dy=0;
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup'])dy=-1;if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown'])dy=1;
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft'])dx=-1;if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright'])dx=1;
  if(dx!==0&&dy!==0){dx*=0.707;dy*=0.707}
  player.x+=dx*player.speed*dt;player.y+=dy*player.speed*dt;
  player.x=Math.max(2*TILE,Math.min((GRIDW-2)*TILE-8,player.x));
  player.y=Math.max(2*TILE,Math.min((GRIDH-2)*TILE-8,player.y));
  cameraX=player.x-W/2;cameraY=player.y-H/2;
  cameraX=Math.max(0,Math.min(GRIDW*TILE-W,cameraX));
  cameraY=Math.max(0,Math.min(GRIDH*TILE-H,cameraY));
  // build cursor from mouse
  buildCursor.x=Math.floor((mouseX+cameraX)/TILE);
  buildCursor.y=Math.floor((mouseY+cameraY)/TILE);
  // available builds
  availableBuilds=[];
  var bc=[{type:'farm',cost:{wood:5,stone:2},label:'Farm'},{type:'cookingfire',cost:{wood:3,stone:5},label:'Cooking Fire'},
    {type:'shelter',cost:{wood:10,stone:5},label:'Shelter'},{type:'outhouse',cost:{wood:3},label:'Outhouse'}];
  bc.forEach(function(b){if(unlockedBuildings.indexOf(b.type)>=0)availableBuilds.push(b)});
  // selection with number keys
  for(var i=0;i<availableBuilds.length;i++){if(keys[''+(i+1)]){buildSelection=i;keys[''+(i+1)]=false}}
  // place
  if(mouseClicked&&buildCursor.x>=2&&buildCursor.x<GRIDW-2&&buildCursor.y>=2&&buildCursor.y<GRIDH-2){
    if(baseGrid[buildCursor.y][buildCursor.x]==='grass'&&buildSelection<availableBuilds.length){
      var sel=availableBuilds[buildSelection];
      var canAfford=true;
      for(var r in sel.cost){if((resources[r]||0)<sel.cost[r])canAfford=false}
      if(canAfford){
        for(var r in sel.cost)resources[r]-=sel.cost[r];
        placeBuilding(sel.type,buildCursor.x,buildCursor.y);
        globalStats.buildingsBuilt++;
        if(sel.type==='shelter')maxFollowers+=2;
        spawnParticles(buildCursor.x*TILE+TILE/2,buildCursor.y*TILE+TILE/2,'#da4',8);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ===== CRUSADE =====
function startCrusade(){
  crusadeRoom=1;crusadeMaxRooms=4;roomCleared=false;
  showRoomChoice=false;showTarotChoice=false;
  collectedLoot={wood:0,stone:0,gold:0,food:0};
  crusadeLootGold=0;crusadeLootWood=0;crusadeLootStone=0;crusadeLootFood=0;
  enemies=[];projectiles=[];lootDrops=[];particles=[];
  tarotCards=[];killCount=0;vampireKillAccum=0;
  currentWeapon=weaponTypes[Math.floor(Math.random()*3)];
  attackTimer=0;attackCooldown=0;isAttacking=false;attackAngle=0;
  dodgeTimer=0;dodgeCooldown=0;isDodging=false;iFrameTimer=0;
  player.hp=player.maxHp;
  player.x=W/2;player.y=H*0.7;player.dir=0;
  spawnRoomEnemies();
}

function spawnRoomEnemies(){
  enemies=[];projectiles=[];lootDrops=[];roomCleared=false;
  if(crusadeRoom===crusadeMaxRooms){spawnBoss();return}
  var count=crusadeRoom+2;
  if(crusadeRegion==='swamp')count=crusadeRoom+2;
  if(crusadeRegion==='mountain')count=crusadeRoom+3;
  for(var i=0;i<count;i++){
    var type;
    if(crusadeRegion==='forest')type=Math.random()<0.5?'wolf':'spider';
    else if(crusadeRegion==='swamp')type=Math.random()<0.5?'snake':'fox';
    else type=['wolf','fox','snake','spider'][Math.floor(Math.random()*4)];
    var ex=100+Math.random()*(W-200),ey=60+Math.random()*(H-200);
    var ehp=type==='wolf'?3:type==='fox'?2:type==='snake'?2:1;
    var espd=type==='spider'?140:type==='wolf'?80:type==='fox'?100:0;
    enemies.push({type:type,x:ex,y:ey,hp:ehp,maxHp:ehp,speed:espd,damage:1,
      attackTimer:1+Math.random(),dir:0,state:'idle',flashTimer:0});
  }
}

function spawnBoss(){
  var bhp,btype;
  if(crusadeRegion==='forest'){bhp=15;btype='Wolf Alpha'}
  else if(crusadeRegion==='swamp'){bhp=18;btype='Serpent King'}
  else{bhp=22;btype='Bear Tyrant'}
  bossHP=bhp;bossMaxHP=bhp;bossType=btype;bossPhase=1;bossAttackTimer=2;bossEnraged=false;
  enemies.push({type:'boss',bossType:btype,x:W/2,y:H*0.3,hp:bhp,maxHp:bhp,speed:60,damage:2,
    attackTimer:2,dir:0,state:'idle',flashTimer:0,isBoss:true});
}

function updateCrusade(dt){
  if(keys['escape']){keys['escape']=false;prevState='CRUSADE';gameState='PAUSE';return}
  if(showRoomChoice){updateRoomChoice(dt);return}
  if(showTarotChoice){updateTarotChoice(dt);return}
  // player movement
  var dx=0,dy=0;
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup'])dy=-1;if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown'])dy=1;
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft'])dx=-1;if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright'])dx=1;
  if(dx!==0&&dy!==0){dx*=0.707;dy*=0.707}
  player.moving=dx!==0||dy!==0;
  if(player.moving)player.dir=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  var spdMult=1;
  tarotCards.forEach(function(c){if(c==='swift')spdMult=1.3});
  // dodge
  if((keys['shift']||keys['Shift'])&&dodgeCooldown<=0&&!isDodging){
    isDodging=true;dodgeTimer=0.2;dodgeCooldown=1;iFrameTimer=0.3;
    dodgeDir=player.dir;
  }
  if(isDodging){
    dodgeTimer-=dt;
    player.x+=Math.cos(dodgeDir)*350*dt;
    player.y+=Math.sin(dodgeDir)*350*dt;
    if(dodgeTimer<=0)isDodging=false;
  }else{
    player.x+=dx*player.speed*spdMult*dt;
    player.y+=dy*player.speed*spdMult*dt;
  }
  dodgeCooldown=Math.max(0,dodgeCooldown-dt);
  iFrameTimer=Math.max(0,iFrameTimer-dt);
  // clamp to arena
  player.x=Math.max(20,Math.min(W-20,player.x));
  player.y=Math.max(20,Math.min(H-40,player.y));
  // attack
  attackCooldown-=dt;
  if((keys[' ']||mouseClicked)&&attackCooldown<=0&&!isDodging){
    isAttacking=true;
    attackAngle=player.dir;
    var weap=currentWeapon;
    var dur=weap==='Sword'?0.4:weap==='Axe'?0.6:0.2;
    var dmg=weap==='Sword'?2:weap==='Axe'?3:1;
    var arc=weap==='Sword'?HALF_PI:weap==='Axe'?PI*2/3:PI/3;
    var rng=weap==='Axe'?55:45;
    attackTimer=dur;attackCooldown=dur+0.05;
    tarotCards.forEach(function(c){if(c==='strength')dmg++});
    // hit enemies
    hitEnemiesInArc(player.x,player.y,rng,attackAngle,arc,dmg);
    if(weap==='Dagger'){setTimeout(function(){hitEnemiesInArc(player.x,player.y,rng,attackAngle,arc,dmg)},100)}
  }
  if(isAttacking){attackTimer-=dt;if(attackTimer<=0)isAttacking=false}
  // enemies
  updateEnemies(dt);
  // projectiles
  updateProjectiles(dt);
  // loot
  updateLoot(dt);
  // particles
  updateParticles(dt);
  // check room clear
  if(!roomCleared&&enemies.length===0){
    roomCleared=true;
    if(crusadeRoom>=crusadeMaxRooms){
      // boss defeated
      if(bossesDefeated.indexOf(crusadeRegion)<0)bossesDefeated.push(crusadeRegion);
      resources.wood+=collectedLoot.wood+8;resources.stone+=collectedLoot.stone+8;
      resources.gold+=collectedLoot.gold+15;resources.food+=collectedLoot.food+8;
      addFollower();dayTimer=0;advanceDay();
      if(bossesDefeated.length>=3){gameOverMsg='victory';startTransition('GAMEOVER');return}
      startTransition('BASE');return;
    }
    // show tarot cards if combat room
    if(tarotCards.length<3){showTarotChoice=true;setupTarotChoice()}
    else{showRoomChoice=true;setupRoomChoices()}
  }
}

function hitEnemiesInArc(ox,oy,range,angle,arc,dmg){
  for(var i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var e=enemies[i];
    var edx=e.x-ox,edy=e.y-oy;
    var dist=Math.sqrt(edx*edx+edy*edy);
    if(dist>range)continue;
    var ang=Math.atan2(edy,edx);
    var diff=ang-angle;
    while(diff>PI)diff-=TWO_PI;while(diff<-PI)diff+=TWO_PI;
    if(Math.abs(diff)<arc/2){
      e.hp-=dmg;e.flashTimer=0.15;
      screenShakeTimer=0.1;
      spawnParticles(e.x,e.y,'#fff',5);
      if(e.hp<=0){
        killCount++;globalStats.enemiesSlain++;
        vampireKillAccum++;
        if(tarotCards.indexOf('vampire')>=0&&vampireKillAccum>=3){player.hp=Math.min(player.maxHp,player.hp+1);vampireKillAccum=0}
        // loot
        var goldMult=1;tarotCards.forEach(function(c){if(c==='miser')goldMult=1.5});
        if(e.isBoss){
          dropLoot(e.x,e.y,Math.floor(15*goldMult),8,8,8);
        }else{
          dropLoot(e.x,e.y,Math.floor((1+Math.random()*2)*goldMult),Math.random()<0.5?1:0,Math.random()<0.5?1:0,Math.random()<0.3?1:0);
        }
        spawnParticles(e.x,e.y,'#f00',10);
        enemies.splice(i,1);
      }
    }
  }
}

function updateEnemies(dt){
  for(var i=0;i<enemies.length;i++){
    var e=enemies[i];
    e.flashTimer=Math.max(0,e.flashTimer-dt);
    e.attackTimer-=dt;
    var edx=player.x-e.x,edy=player.y-e.y;
    var dist=Math.sqrt(edx*edx+edy*edy);
    e.dir=Math.atan2(edy,edx);
    if(e.isBoss){updateBoss(e,dt,dist);continue}
    if(e.type==='wolf'){
      if(dist<100&&e.attackTimer<=0){e.x+=edx/dist*300*dt;e.y+=edy/dist*300*dt;if(dist<30){tryDamagePlayer(e.damage);e.attackTimer=1.5}}
      else if(dist>30){e.x+=edx/dist*e.speed*dt;e.y+=edy/dist*e.speed*dt}
    }else if(e.type==='fox'){
      var orbit=120;
      if(e.attackTimer<=0){e.x+=edx/dist*200*dt;e.y+=edy/dist*200*dt;if(dist<30){tryDamagePlayer(e.damage);e.attackTimer=2}}
      else{var perpX=-edy/dist,perpY=edx/dist;
        if(dist<orbit-10){e.x-=edx/dist*e.speed*dt*0.5;e.y-=edy/dist*e.speed*dt*0.5}
        else if(dist>orbit+10){e.x+=edx/dist*e.speed*dt;e.y+=edy/dist*e.speed*dt}
        e.x+=perpX*e.speed*dt*0.7;e.y+=perpY*e.speed*dt*0.7}
    }else if(e.type==='snake'){
      if(e.attackTimer<=0){e.attackTimer=2;
        projectiles.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,dx:edx/dist*150,dy:edy/dist*150,life:3,damage:1,enemy:true,color:'#0f0'})}
    }else if(e.type==='spider'){
      e.x+=edx/dist*e.speed*dt+(Math.random()-0.5)*60*dt;
      e.y+=edy/dist*e.speed*dt+(Math.random()-0.5)*60*dt;
      if(dist<25&&e.attackTimer<=0){tryDamagePlayer(e.damage);e.attackTimer=1}
    }
    e.x=Math.max(10,Math.min(W-10,e.x));e.y=Math.max(10,Math.min(H-10,e.y));
  }
}

function updateBoss(e,dt,dist){
  var edx=player.x-e.x,edy=player.y-e.y;
  if(e.hp<=e.maxHp/2&&!bossEnraged){bossEnraged=true;e.flashTimer=0.5}
  var spdMult=bossEnraged?1.4:1;
  var atkMult=bossEnraged?0.6:1;
  if(e.attackTimer<=0){
    var atk=Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
    if(e.bossType==='Wolf Alpha'){
      if(atk===0){// charge
        var cx=edx/dist*400*dt*spdMult;var cy=edy/dist*400*dt*spdMult;
        e.x+=cx*10;e.y+=cy*10;if(dist<50)tryDamagePlayer(2);e.attackTimer=2*atkMult;
      }else if(atk===1){// bite
        if(dist<60)tryDamagePlayer(1);e.attackTimer=1.5*atkMult;
      }else{// howl - summon wolves
        for(var s=0;s<2;s++){enemies.push({type:'wolf',x:e.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*100,y:e.y+60+Math.random()*40,hp:2,maxHp:2,speed:80,damage:1,attackTimer:1,dir:0,state:'idle',flashTimer:0})}
        e.attackTimer=3*atkMult;
      }
    }else if(e.bossType==='Serpent King'){
      if(atk===0){// multi-shot
        for(var a=-0.3;a<=0.3;a+=0.3){var ang=e.dir+a;
          projectiles.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,dx:Math.cos(ang)*130,dy:Math.sin(ang)*130,life:3,damage:1,enemy:true,color:'#0a0'})}
        e.attackTimer=2*atkMult;
      }else if(atk===1){// coil strike
        e.x+=edx/dist*200;e.y+=edy/dist*200;if(dist<60)tryDamagePlayer(2);e.attackTimer=2*atkMult;
      }else{// poison pool
        projectiles.push({x:player.x,y:player.y,dx:0,dy:0,life:3,damage:0.5,enemy:true,color:'#2a0',isPool:true,radius:50});
        e.attackTimer=3*atkMult;
      }
    }else{// Bear Tyrant
      if(atk===0){// slam AOE
        if(dist<80)tryDamagePlayer(2);screenShakeTimer=0.3;spawnParticles(e.x,e.y,'#a60',15);e.attackTimer=2.5*atkMult;
      }else if(atk===1){// charge
        e.x+=edx/dist*250;e.y+=edy/dist*250;if(dist<60)tryDamagePlayer(3);e.attackTimer=2*atkMult;
      }else{// summon
        for(var s=0;s<2;s++){var rt=['wolf','spider','fox','snake'][Math.floor(Math.random()*4)];
          var ehp2=rt==='wolf'?3:rt==='fox'?2:rt==='snake'?2:1;var espd2=rt==='spider'?140:rt==='wolf'?80:rt==='fox'?100:0;
          enemies.push({type:rt,x:e.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*100,y:e.y+50,hp:ehp2,maxHp:ehp2,speed:espd2,damage:1,attackTimer:1+Math.random(),dir:0,state:'idle',flashTimer:0})}
        e.attackTimer=4*atkMult;
      }
    }
  }else{
    // move toward player
    if(dist>60){e.x+=edx/dist*e.speed*spdMult*dt;e.y+=edy/dist*e.speed*spdMult*dt}
  }
  e.x=Math.max(30,Math.min(W-30,e.x));e.y=Math.max(30,Math.min(H-30,e.y));
}

function tryDamagePlayer(dmg){
  if(iFrameTimer>0||isDodging)return;
  player.hp-=dmg;iFrameTimer=0.5;screenShakeTimer=0.15;
  spawnParticles(player.x,player.y,'#f00',8);
  if(player.hp<=0){
    // death - return to base with half loot
    collectedLoot.wood=Math.floor(collectedLoot.wood/2);collectedLoot.stone=Math.floor(collectedLoot.stone/2);
    collectedLoot.gold=Math.floor(collectedLoot.gold/2);collectedLoot.food=Math.floor(collectedLoot.food/2);
    resources.wood+=collectedLoot.wood;resources.stone+=collectedLoot.stone;
    resources.gold+=collectedLoot.gold;resources.food+=collectedLoot.food;
    dayTimer=0;advanceDay();
    startTransition('BASE');
  }
}

function updateProjectiles(dt){
  for(var i=projectiles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var p=projectiles[i];
    p.life-=dt;
    if(p.life<=0){projectiles.splice(i,1);continue}
    if(!p.isPool){p.x+=p.dx*dt;p.y+=p.dy*dt}
    if(p.enemy){
      // check hit player
      var pdx=player.x-p.x,pdy=player.y-p.y;
      var pdist=Math.sqrt(pdx*pdx+pdy*pdy);
      var hitR=p.isPool?p.radius:15;
      if(pdist<hitR){
        if(p.isPool){tryDamagePlayer(Math.ceil(p.damage*dt*2))}
        else{tryDamagePlayer(p.damage);projectiles.splice(i,1)}
      }
    }
  }
}

function dropLoot(x,y,gold,wood,stone,food){
  if(gold>0)lootDrops.push({x:x+(Math.random()-0.5)*30,y:y+(Math.random()-0.5)*30,type:'gold',amount:gold});
  if(wood>0)lootDrops.push({x:x+(Math.random()-0.5)*30,y:y+(Math.random()-0.5)*30,type:'wood',amount:wood});

function updateLoot(dt){

    if(ldist<80){l.x+=ldx/ldist*200*dt;l.y+=ldy/ldist*200*dt}

function setupTarotChoice(){
  var all=[{id:'strength',name:'The Strength',desc:'+1 damage'},{id:'shield',name:'The Shield',desc:'+2 max HP'},
    {id:'swift',name:'The Swift',desc:'+30% speed'},{id:'vampire',name:'The Vampire',desc:'Heal 1 HP per 3 kills'},
    {id:'miser',name:'The Miser',desc:'+50% gold'},{id:'lucky',name:'The Lucky',desc:'Better loot'}];
  // remove already owned
  all=all.filter(function(c){return tarotCards.indexOf(c.id)<0});
  tarotChoices=[];
  while(tarotChoices.length<2&&all.length>0){var idx=Math.floor(Math.random()*all.length);tarotChoices.push(all.splice(idx,1)[0])}
}

function updateTarotChoice(dt){
  if(!mouseClicked)return;
  for(var i=0;i<tarotChoices.length;i++){
    var cx=W/2+(i===0?-90:90),cy=H/2;
    if(mouseX>cx-70&&mouseX<cx+70&&mouseY>cy-90&&mouseY<cy+90){
      var card=tarotChoices[i];
      tarotCards.push(card.id);
      if(card.id==='shield'){player.maxHp+=2;player.hp+=2}
      showTarotChoice=false;
      showRoomChoice=true;setupRoomChoices();
      return;
    }
  }
}

function setupRoomChoices(){
  var types=['combat','treasure','rescue','health'];
  roomChoices=[];
  for(var i=0;i<2;i++){roomChoices.push(types[Math.floor(Math.random()*types.length)])}
}

function updateRoomChoice(dt){
  if(!mouseClicked)return;
  for(var i=0;i<roomChoices.length;i++){
    var cx=W/2+(i===0?-100:100),cy=H/2;
    if(mouseX>cx-70&&mouseX<cx+70&&mouseY>cy-40&&mouseY<cy+40){
      crusadeRoom++;
      var choice=roomChoices[i];
      showRoomChoice=false;
      if(choice==='combat'){spawnRoomEnemies()}
      else if(choice==='treasure'){
        collectedLoot.gold+=8+Math.floor(Math.random()*8);
        collectedLoot.wood+=5+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
        roomCleared=true;
        if(crusadeRoom<crusadeMaxRooms){showRoomChoice=true;setupRoomChoices()}
        else{spawnRoomEnemies()}
      }
      else if(choice==='rescue'){
        pendingFollower=true;
        roomCleared=true;
        if(crusadeRoom<crusadeMaxRooms){showRoomChoice=true;setupRoomChoices()}
        else{spawnRoomEnemies()}
      }
      else if(choice==='health'){
        player.hp=Math.min(player.maxHp,player.hp+4);
        spawnParticles(player.x,player.y,'#f0f',10);
        roomCleared=true;
        if(crusadeRoom<crusadeMaxRooms){showRoomChoice=true;setupRoomChoices()}
        else{spawnRoomEnemies()}
      }
      return;
    }
  }
}

  ctx.fillStyle='#555';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+bob,16,12,0,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle='#EEE';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-10+bob,10,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle='#f00';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-3,y-12+bob,2.5,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+3,y-12+bob,2.5,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  // crown
  ctx.fillStyle='#c00';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-6,y-19+bob);ctx.lineTo(x-3,y-25+bob);ctx.lineTo(x,y-19+bob);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-1,y-19+bob);ctx.lineTo(x,y-28+bob);ctx.lineTo(x+1,y-19+bob);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y-19+bob);ctx.lineTo(x+3,y-25+bob);ctx.lineTo(x+6,y-19+bob);ctx.fill();
  // weapon
  if(isAttacking){
    var wLen=currentWeapon==='Axe'?30:currentWeapon==='Sword'?25:18;
    var wAng=attackAngle+Math.sin(attackTimer*20)*0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle='#ccc';ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y+bob);ctx.lineTo(x+Math.cos(wAng)*wLen,y+bob+Math.sin(wAng)*wLen);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth=1;
  }
  // legs
  ctx.fillStyle='#333';
  ctx.fillRect(x-10,y+8+bob,4,7);ctx.fillRect(x-3,y+8+bob,4,7);
  ctx.fillRect(x+2,y+8+bob,4,7);ctx.fillRect(x+7,y+8+bob,4,7);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function drawEnemy(e){
  var x=e.x,y=e.y;
  if(e.flashTimer>0){ctx.globalAlpha=0.5}
  if(e.isBoss){
    var s=e.bossType==='Serpent King'?1:1;
    var sz=28;
    if(e.bossType==='Wolf Alpha'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#555';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,sz,sz*0.7,0,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#444';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-15,y-sz*0.6);ctx.lineTo(x-8,y-sz);ctx.lineTo(x-2,y-sz*0.5);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+2,y-sz*0.5);ctx.lineTo(x+8,y-sz);ctx.lineTo(x+15,y-sz*0.6);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-8,y-6,4,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+8,y-6,4,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      if(bossEnraged){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,0,0,0.5)';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,sz+5,0,TWO_PI);ctx.stroke();ctx.lineWidth=1}
    }else if(e.bossType==='Serpent King'){
      ctx.fillStyle='#228B22';
      for(var seg=0;seg<4;seg++){var sx=x+Math.sin(titlePulse+seg)*12,sy=y-20+seg*14;
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,10-seg,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill()}
      ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-5,y-24,3,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+5,y-24,3,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle='#f00';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y-16);ctx.lineTo(x+8,y-12);ctx.moveTo(x,y-16);ctx.lineTo(x-8,y-12);ctx.stroke();ctx.lineWidth=1;
    }else{// Bear Tyrant
      ctx.fillStyle='#4A2810';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,sz,sz*0.8,0,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#3a1808';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y-16,16,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#f00';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-6,y-18,4,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+6,y-18,4,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
      // runes
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,0,0,'+(0.3+0.3*Math.sin(titlePulse*2))+')';ctx.lineWidth=2;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,16,0,PI);ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-8,y-4);ctx.lineTo(x+8,y+4);ctx.stroke();ctx.lineWidth=1;
    }
    // boss health bar
    ctx.fillStyle='#333';ctx.fillRect(x-30,y-sz-14,60,8);
    ctx.fillStyle=e.hp>e.maxHp/2?'#c00':'#f60';ctx.fillRect(x-30,y-sz-14,60*(e.hp/e.maxHp),8);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#000';ctx.strokeRect(x-30,y-sz-14,60,8);
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;return;
  }
  if(e.type==='wolf'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#555';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,14,10,0,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#444';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-8,y-8);ctx.lineTo(x-5,y-15);ctx.lineTo(x-2,y-8);ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+2,y-8);ctx.lineTo(x+5,y-15);ctx.lineTo(x+8,y-8);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-4,y-3,2,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+4,y-3,2,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-3,y+4);ctx.lineTo(x,y+7);ctx.lineTo(x+3,y+4);ctx.fill();
  }else if(e.type==='fox'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#FF6600';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,12,9,0,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+2,6,5,0,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#f00';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-3,y-3,2,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+3,y-3,2,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  }else if(e.type==='snake'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#228B22';
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-10,y+5);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x-5,y-10,x+5,y+10,x+10,y-5);ctx.lineWidth=6;ctx.strokeStyle='#228B22';ctx.stroke();ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.fillStyle='#FFD700';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+8,y-6,2,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#f00';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+12,y-4);ctx.lineTo(x+16,y-6);ctx.moveTo(x+12,y-4);ctx.lineTo(x+16,y-2);ctx.stroke();
  }else if(e.type==='spider'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#222';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,6,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#333';ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(var l=0;l<8;l++){var la=l*PI/4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+Math.cos(la)*6,y+Math.sin(la)*6);ctx.lineTo(x+Math.cos(la)*14,y+Math.sin(la)*14);ctx.stroke()}
    ctx.fillStyle='#f00';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x-2,y-2,1.5,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+2,y-2,1.5,0,TWO_PI);ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}

function renderRoomChoice(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffd700';ctx.font=FONTL;ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('Room Cleared!',W/2,H/2-100);
  ctx.font=FONTB;ctx.fillStyle='#ccc';
  ctx.fillText('Choose your next path:',W/2,H/2-60);
  for(var i=0;i<roomChoices.length;i++){
    var cx=W/2+(i===0?-100:100),cy=H/2;
    var hover=mouseX>cx-70&&mouseX<cx+70&&mouseY>cy-40&&mouseY<cy+40;
    ctx.fillStyle=hover?'rgba(150,50,50,0.8)':'rgba(40,40,60,0.8)';
    roundRect(cx-70,cy-40,140,80,8,true,false);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#888';roundRect(cx-70,cy-40,140,80,8,false,true);
    var icons={combat:'Sword',treasure:'Gem',rescue:'Sheep',health:'Heart'};
    var colors={combat:'#f66',treasure:'#fd0',rescue:'#6f6',health:'#f6f'};
    ctx.fillStyle=colors[roomChoices[i]];ctx.font=FONTL;
    ctx.fillText(icons[roomChoices[i]],cx,cy+4);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ddd';ctx.font='12px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(roomChoices[i].toUpperCase(),cx,cy+30);
  }
}

function renderTarotChoiceUI(){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.fillStyle='#9b59b6';ctx.font=FONTL;ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('Choose a Tarot Card',W/2,H/2-110);
  for(var i=0;i<tarotChoices.length;i++){
    var cx=W/2+(i===0?-90:90),cy=H/2;
    var hover=mouseX>cx-70&&mouseX<cx+70&&mouseY>cy-90&&mouseY<cy+90;
    ctx.fillStyle=hover?'rgba(100,30,130,0.9)':'rgba(40,20,60,0.9)';
    roundRect(cx-70,cy-80,140,160,8,true,false);
    ctx.strokeStyle=hover?'#d4a0ff':'#666';ctx.lineWidth=2;roundRect(cx-70,cy-80,140,160,8,false,true);ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.fillStyle='#e0c0ff';ctx.font=FONTB;
    ctx.fillText(tarotChoices[i].name,cx,cy-30);
    ctx.fillStyle='#bbb';ctx.font='13px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(tarotChoices[i].desc,cx,cy+10);
  }
}

function renderCrusadeHUD(){
  // HP hearts
  var hearts=Math.ceil(player.maxHp/2);
  for(var i=0;i<hearts;i++){
    var hx=15+i*28,hy=15;
    var full=player.hp>=(i+1)*2;
    var half=player.hp>=(i*2+1);
    drawHeart(hx,hy,full?'#f00':half?'#f66':'#444');
  }
  // Room
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font=FONTB;ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('Room '+crusadeRoom+'/'+crusadeMaxRooms+' — '+crusadeRegion.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+crusadeRegion.slice(1),W/2,22);
  // weapon
  ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillStyle='#ccc';ctx.font='13px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('Weapon: '+currentWeapon,10,H-15);
  // collected loot
  ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillStyle='#fd0';ctx.font='13px monospace';
  ctx.fillText('G:'+collectedLoot.gold+' W:'+collectedLoot.wood+' S:'+collectedLoot.stone+' F:'+collectedLoot.food,W-10,22);
  // tarot cards
  if(tarotCards.length>0){
    ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillStyle='#c0a0ff';
    for(var i=0;i<tarotCards.length;i++){
      ctx.fillText(tarotCards[i],W-10,H-15-i*16);
    }
  }
}

function drawHeart(x,y,color){
  ctx.fillStyle=color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x,y+4);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x,y,x-8,y-4,x-8,y+2);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x-8,y+8,x,y+14,x,y+14);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x,y+14,x+8,y+8,x+8,y+2);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+8,y-4,x,y,x,y+4);
  ctx.fill();
}

// ===== UTILITY =====
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);
  ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);
  ctx.closePath();
  if(fill)ctx.fill();if(stroke)ctx.stroke();
}

// ===== START =====
if(getW()>0&&getH()>0){init()}else{var _iv=setInterval(function(){if(getW()>0&&getH()>0){clearInterval(_iv);init()}},100)}
})();
